'''Freid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served as a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Private Freid was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], and served in a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] commanded by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Yuun (Gand)|Yuun]].
